parts:
I'm having the same problems as what's been posted to the list. Here are characteristics:
  1. Shiny app runs fine locally in-browser.
  2. Publish online on Shinyapps.io, deployed without error from RStudio.
  3. Go to URL, page pauses for 1-2 seconds* then displays "Disconnected from server." drop-down error. Click button to reload, same thing.
  4. No log data --> "This application currently has no logs." in dashboard.
  5. Dashboard memory usage shows <30 MB since app was deployed.
I literally just deployed the app, but I can't see why this would make any difference. My app involves a few things that might be of note:
  • Google Visualizations from the GVis package, *which seem to produce a 1-2 second delay even when they're run locally.
  • 2 calls to external API data sources that are made outside of ShinyServer(), so presumably (AFAIK) that means that they're only run 1 time at the start of the application, which is my intention, rather than with every page view.
Other than that, it's really not that special. The app draws a map and displays a chart. What's going on?

FYI for everyone:

I was using the "JSONlite" package in my app. Here's some technobabble from a subsequently deleted Github issue about how JSONlite sometimes needs HTTR, and sometimes doesn't (?!?). Due to this behavior, explicitly calling library(httr) is apparently necessary. This removed my problem.

Soo... hooray for hidden dependency bombs?
